title: Olivia Rodrigo & Dan Nigro
sub: Olivia Rodrigo brought her producer Dan Nigro onto a station her fans run and they went through the album together. 6,858 people were in the show. In this half minute she asks him which song on the record is his favourite, and 440 people are chatting while he answers.
context: Olivia brought her producer along to a station her fans built. The room wanted to know his favourite song on the record, so she asked him, and the two of them turned out to agree.
claim:
The two people who made the record,
talking about how.

phaseLive: She is on with her producer
